30 Ladder Door Pull with 18 Center to Centers

text.description_html:
30" Shower Door Pull

The 30 Inch Glass Door Ladder Pull comes back-to-back--pulls bolt to each other through the door--with mounting hardware for glass doors. These are ideal for use as shower handles; but they are just as well used on glass doors throughout your home or office. The modern design keeps them from making them stand out too much on glass for that seamless look that contemporary design is all about. Available in decorating's most popular finish choices: polished chrome, satin nickel, and oil rubbed bronze.

Also Available Matching 30" Ladder Pull for metal or wood doors.

Specifications and Features of the 30" Contemporary Door Pull:

  • Overall Length: 30"
  • Mounting Length: 18" Center to Center
  • Pull Diameter: 3/4" Round Tubing
  • Mounting Point Diameter: 27/32"
  • Overall Projection: 2-15/32"
  • Clearance: 1-1/32"
  • Inner Contact Tubing: 5/6" (16 mm)
  • For 5/16" (8 mm) to 1/2" (12 mm) thick glass
  • Comes packaged as a back-to-back pair with mounting hardware for glass doors.

Sold as a Pair (2 door pull handles) for Glass Door.
